```{r}
library(dplyr)

# 1. compute sentence-level mean valence (across participants)
sent_mean <- df %>%
  group_by(story, segID) %>%
  summarize(sent_meanV = mean(V, na.rm = TRUE), n_obs = sum(!is.na(V)), .groups = "drop")

# 2. derive sign from the sentence mean using your thresholds
sent_mean <- sent_mean %>%
  mutate(V_sign = case_when(
    sent_meanV >  1.5  ~ "positive",
    sent_meanV < -1.5  ~ "negative",
    TRUE             ~ "neutral"
  )) %>%
  mutate(V_sign = factor(V_sign, levels = c("negative", "neutral", "positive")))

# 3. join back to original df
df <- df %>%
  left_join(select(sent_mean, story, segID, sent_meanV, V_sign), by = c("story", "segID"))

# quick check
table(df$V_sign, useNA = "ifany")
head(df[, c("story","segID","sent_meanV","V_sign")])


df$V_sign <- relevel(factor(df$V_sign, levels = c("negative", "neutral", "positive")),ref = 'neutral')


df_avgAcrossSeg <- df %>%
  group_by(group, idx, audio, voice,V_sign) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), mean, na.rm = TRUE))

df$story_seg <- interaction(df$story, df$segID, drop = TRUE)
df$subID     <- factor(df$subID)   # ensure subject ID is a factor if not already
df$story      <- factor(df$story)
df$segID      <- factor(df$segID)
df$story_seg  <- interaction(df$story, df$segID, drop = TRUE)
df$voice      <- factor(df$voice)
df$sex        <- factor(df$sex, levels = c("male","female"))

```

#### M1: GAM, controlling for sex, voice, and arousal

```{r}
library(mgcv)
m1 <- try(bam(V ~ s(age, k=5) + sex + A + voice + s(subID, bs="re") +
                s(story, bs="re") + s(story_seg, bs="re"),
              data = df, method = "fREML", nthreads = 8))
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(m1)
summary(m1)
filename <- 'results_GAM_m1.rds'
Dir_output <-  file.path(Dir_github,'derivatives','behavioral','qualtrics','analysis_glm')
saveRDS(m1, file =file.path(Dir_output,filename))

###
filename <- 'results_GAM_m1.rds'
Dir_output <-  file.path(Dir_github,'derivatives','behavioral','qualtrics','analysis_glm')
m1 <- readRDS(file.path(Dir_output, filename))

age_grid <- data.frame(
  age = seq(min(df$age, na.rm = TRUE), max(df$age, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 300),
  sex = levels(df$sex)[1],            # use any valid level; smooth is shared across sexes in m1
  A = 0,                              # typical value you used before
  voice = levels(df$voice)[1],        # valid factor level
  subID = levels(df$subID)[1],        # valid factor level (dummy)
  story = levels(df$story)[1],
  story_seg = levels(df$story_seg)[1]
)

# 2. Predict the term "s(age)" only (gives the partial / centered smooth)
terms_pred <- predict(
  m1,
  newdata = age_grid,
  type = "terms",
  se.fit = TRUE,
  terms = "s(age)"
)

# terms_pred$fit is a matrix (columns = terms). Extract the s(age) column.
# Column name may be exactly "s(age)" or "s(age, k=...)" depending on mgcv version;
# use grep to be robust:
term_col_name <- colnames(terms_pred$fit)[grep("^s\\(age", colnames(terms_pred$fit))]
fit_vals <- as.numeric(terms_pred$fit[, term_col_name])
se_vals  <- as.numeric(terms_pred$se.fit[, term_col_name])

age_grid$s_age_fit   <- fit_vals
age_grid$s_age_se    <- se_vals
age_grid$s_age_upper <- fit_vals + 1.96 * se_vals
age_grid$s_age_lower <- fit_vals - 1.96 * se_vals

# 3. (Optional) get estimated df for label like "s(age, 3.49)"
s_tab <- summary(m1)$s.table
# find the right row ~ starts with "s(age"
row_idx <- grep("^s\\(age", rownames(s_tab))
edf_val <- if (length(row_idx)) round(s_tab[row_idx, "edf"], 2) else NA
smooth_label <- if (!is.na(edf_val)) paste0("s(age, ", edf_val, ")") else "s(age)"

# 4. Plot with ggplot: line + dashed CI boundaries + ribbon (matching base plot style)
p_m1 <- ggplot(age_grid, aes(x = age)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = s_age_lower, ymax = s_age_upper), fill = "grey80", alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_line(aes(y = s_age_fit), size = 1, colour = "black") +
  geom_line(aes(y = s_age_upper), colour = "black") +
  geom_line(aes(y = s_age_lower), colour = "black") +
  #geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "black", size = 0.4) +
  #labs(x = "age", y = smooth_label) +
    labs(
    x = "Age",
    y = "Predicted valence rating",
  )  +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    legend.position = c(0.05, 0.05),   # <-- THIS works everywhere
    legend.justification = c("left", "bottom"),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  )
  
print(p_m1)

filename <- 'fig_GAM_m1.jpg'
ggsave(
  filename = filename,
  plot = p_m1,
  path = Dir_output,
  width = 7,
  height = 5,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300
)

```

#### examine outliers

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
age_grid <- data.frame(
  age = seq(min(df$age), max(df$age), length.out = 200),
  sex = levels(df$sex)[1],
  A = 0,
  voice = levels(df$voice)[1],
  subID = levels(df$subID)[1],
  story = levels(df$story)[1],
  story_seg = levels(df$story_seg)[1]
)

pred <- predict(
  m1,
  newdata = age_grid,
  se.fit = TRUE,
  exclude = c("s(subID)", "s(story)", "s(story_seg)")
)

age_grid$fit <- pred$fit
age_grid$se  <- pred$se.fit


ggplot() +

  # raw data (density & outliers)
  geom_point(
    data = df,
    aes(x = age, y = V),
    alpha = 0.05,
    size = 0.4,
    color = "grey30"
  ) +

  # model-based CI
  geom_ribbon(
    data = age_grid,
    aes(x = age, ymin = fit-1.96*se, ymax = fit+1.96*se),
    fill = "red",
    alpha = 0.25
  ) +

  # model-based smooth
  geom_line(
    data = age_grid,
    aes(x = age, y = fit),
    color = "red",
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +

  # peak reference
  #geom_vline(xintercept = 58, linetype = "dashed") +

  labs(
    x = "Age",
    y = "Valence",
    title = "Segment-level valence ratings with the predicted age effect"
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)



```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

sub_means <- df %>%
  group_by(subID) %>%
  summarise(age = first(age), meanV = mean(V, na.rm = TRUE), n = n(), .groups = "drop")

# model-based smooth (population-level) as before
pred <- predict(m1, newdata = age_grid, se.fit = TRUE,
                exclude = c("s(subID)","s(story)","s(story_seg)"))
age_grid$fit <- pred$fit
age_grid$lower <- pred$fit - 1.96*pred$se.fit
age_grid$upper <- pred$fit + 1.96*pred$se.fit

ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = sub_means, aes(x = age, y = meanV), alpha = 0.8, size = 2) +
  geom_line(data = age_grid, aes(x = age, y = fit), color = "red", size = 1) +
  geom_ribbon(data = age_grid, aes(x = age, ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
              fill = "red", alpha = 0.2) +
  labs(x = "Age", y = "Participant mean valence",
       title = "Participant-level valence ratings with the predicted age effect") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
)
```

```{r}
age_grid_m3$se    <- pred_m3$se.fit
age_grid_m3$lower <- age_grid_m3$fit - 1.96 * age_grid_m3$se
```

#### M4: GAM, age \* V_sign \* sex, controlling for voice, and arousal

```{r}
m4 <- try(bam(V ~ s(age, by = interaction(V_sign,sex), k=5) + V_sign + sex + A + voice + s(subID, bs="re") +
                s(story, bs="re") + s(story_seg, bs="re"),
              data = df, method = "fREML", nthreads = 24))
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(m4)
filename <- 'results_GAM_m4.rds'
Dir_output <-  file.path(Dir_github,'derivatives','behavioral','qualtrics','analysis_glm')
saveRDS(m4, file =file.path(Dir_output,filename))
summary(m4)

# ---- helper: function to build grid, predict, and return dataframe ----
predict_age_by_sex <- function(model, df, sex_val, n_age = 200) {
  # ensure sex_val exists
  if (!sex_val %in% levels(df$sex)) stop("sex_val not found in df$sex levels")
  
  age_seq <- seq(min(df$age, na.rm = TRUE),
                 max(df$age, na.rm = TRUE),
                 length.out = n_age)
  
  newgrid <- expand.grid(
    age = age_seq,
    V_sign = levels(df$V_sign),
    sex = sex_val,
    A = 0,                               # centered arousal (adjust if needed)
    voice = levels(df$voice)[1],         # reference voice
    subID = levels(df$subID)[1],         # dummy valid level for predict
    story = levels(df$story)[1],
    story_seg = levels(df$story_seg)[1]
  )
  
  pred <- predict(
    model,
    newdata = newgrid,
    se.fit = TRUE,
    exclude = c("s(subID)", "s(story)", "s(story_seg)")
  )
  
  newgrid$fit   <- pred$fit
  newgrid$se    <- pred$se.fit
  newgrid$lower <- newgrid$fit - 1.96 * newgrid$se
  newgrid$upper <- newgrid$fit + 1.96 * newgrid$se
  
  return(newgrid)
}

# ---- colors (same as your script) ----
polarity_colors <- c(
  "neutral"  = "forestgreen",
  "negative" = "firebrick",
  "positive" = "steelblue"
)

# ---- get sexes in data ----
sexes <- levels(df$sex)
if (length(sexes) < 2) {
  warning("Less than 2 levels in df$sex; check your factor.")
}

# ---- predict for each sex ----
age_grid_male   <- predict_age_by_sex(m4, df, sex_val = sexes[ which(tolower(sexes) %in% c("male","m"))[1] %||% sexes[1] ])
# If the above fancy lookup fails, fallback to sexes[1] (safe)
# But simpler: just pick explicit strings if you prefer:
# age_grid_male <- predict_age_by_sex(m4, df, sex_val = "male")

# For female: try to find female level robustly
female_idx <- which(tolower(sexes) %in% c("female","f"))
if (length(female_idx) == 0) {
  # fallback to second level if exists
  female_val <- ifelse(length(sexes) >= 2, sexes[2], sexes[1])
} else {
  female_val <- sexes[female_idx[1]]
}
age_grid_female <- predict_age_by_sex(m4, df, sex_val = female_val)


age_grid_both <- rbind(age_grid_male, age_grid_female)

p_combined <- ggplot(age_grid_both,
       aes(x = age, y = fit, color = V_sign, fill = V_sign)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
              alpha = 0.25, color = NA) +
  scale_color_manual(values = polarity_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = polarity_colors) +
  facet_wrap(~ sex, nrow = 1,labeller = labeller(sex = tools::toTitleCase)) +
  labs(
    x = "Age",
    y = "Predicted valence rating",
    color = "Valence polarity",
    fill  = "Valence polarity"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)+
  scale_color_manual(
    values = polarity_colors,
    labels = tools::toTitleCase
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = polarity_colors,
    labels = tools::toTitleCase
  )+ theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14)
)
```
